android/app/src/main/java/net/wingress/m.description: Activity lifecycle, incoming share/app links, fullscreen system bars and PiP actions/bounds.
Application dependency construction, shared repository state and context reset propagation.
Registration/session models, guided API permissions, scope validation and expiry choices.
AiSList settings/decisions, versioned bounded classification cache, batching, retries and shared lookups.
All shared preference defaults, JSON parsing, sparse patches/merges, homepage/caption/codec rules.
Existing avatar metadata parsing, same-instance image proxy normalization, Unicode initials and redirect-free image client.
Website-compatible English language choices for three caption priorities.
Description timestamp chapter parsing, validity, availability and current-chapter rules.
Native/upstream clip identity and bounds, title/time validation, eligibility, default ranges and storyboard VTT cues.
Read-only comment models, target/reply pagination controller, position retention and native link mapping.
Community attachments/posts, post links, owner metadata and banner/post-image proxy rules.
Native/external link targets, validated URL/timestamps/indexes, nullable playback overrides/bounds and share URLs.
Member/block visibility by surface, raw-page merging, search exceptions and confirmed blocked-channel repository.
Title/private-identity validation and bounded, deduplicated replacement-title lookups.
Stable local ownership namespaces, checked migration/transfer/purge and strict guest preference normalization.
Trending categories, localized region catalog and typed mixed-search parsing/visibility/exhaustion.
Localized compact/grouped counts, precision, size/bitrate/time/date formatting and strict non-negative numeric parsing.
SQLite JSON journal, DownloadManager enqueue/reconciliation/retry/cancel/delete, content validation and broadcast receiver.
Download catalog/selection/asset/record/status models and readiness rules.
Organized/legacy history parsing, server-calendar grouping and scoped search input/page state.
Cancellable asynchronous OkHttp response-body adapter and closed-response transport snapshot.
Complete instance HTTP client, auth/error/cache semantics and consumed API endpoint methods.
Replay chunks/settings, RE2 filters, bounded presentation-driven replay windows and timing sync.
Core video/channel/playlist/account/context/stream models and defensive API JSON parsing.
Occurrence/source/snapshot models, source-page merging, insertion/removal/repeat/eligibility and save/block state.
Hashed device-private feed snapshots with age, size and count bounds and atomic replacement.
Validated public/private/mix feed URL construction and RSS/OPML/Atom panel state.
Encrypted session, checked SharedPreferences, context generation and profile-local/device-wide settings access.
Segment/settings/category/mode/color/channel models, parsing, sparse patches and validation.
Directory statistics, local search/sort fallback and revision-fenced confirmed subscription mutations.
Watched/progress models and indicators plus revision-fenced history/progress reconciliation and local fallback.
Foreground file copying, MP4 merging/consented conversion, output validation, progress, cleanup and interruption journal.
Supported DASH codec/preset selection before initial media requests, retaining adaptive decoder checks.
Local single/paired media sources and completed captions without remote metadata.
Pure seek, explicit/resume start, completion save and bounded-link rules.
ExoPlayer/MediaSession lifetime, trusted commands, history/progress ownership, SponsorBlock and PiP transport actions.
Service-owned lazy resolution, source pagination, occurrence transitions, tracks, bounds, offline media, clips and successor behavior.
Logical system-session queue timeline, safe durations, placeholders and forwarding seeks/repeat to coordinator.
Ten-second tap accumulation with monotonic 600ms deadline and cancellation.
Non-live window epoch normalization for safe Media3 session serialization.
Overlapping automatic skips, manual offers, dismissal and playback-session segment history.
Supported representation identity, API metadata matching, audio grouping, menu pruning and codec/quality selection.
Decoded aspect ratio, embedded sizing, orientation and exact bounded PiP fractions.
Occurrence-owned Auto/Preset/Manual video policy and reload fallback.
Pure nested-scroll consumption rules for compact/expanded watch resizing.
Sign-in/register/captcha, credentials, account deletion, sessions and token forms with transient secret handling.
Shared independently recorded popup/overflow menus, actions and dropdown settings choices.
Accessible classification warning thumbnails replacing artwork when configured.
Nine-zone spatial palette extraction and one-copy rate/backoff/generation gate.
App-facing StateFlows, browse/navigation snapshots, account/library actions, preference writes and MediaController coordination.
Redirect-free Coil avatar loader, fallback identity, creator/channel headers and subscription chips.
Measured floating browse toolbars, separate backdrop recording, content padding and artwork surfaces.
Adaptive creator description sheet with native rich links.
Current chapter label and retained chapter panel/sheet state with seek actions.
Clip resolution/editor draft, validation, publication and occurrence-owned preview state.
Clip cards/details/share/delete, foreign-origin dialog, independent preview and draggable filmstrip editor.
Comment entry/drawer/replies, native rich text/emoji/link parsing, sorting and read-only presentation.
Related channel/post cards, inline expansion, post details/comments, share and image gallery/viewer.
Original/replacement title controls, private identity form and reviewed proposal/vote panel.
Searchable country choice/picker and Trending category/region controls.
Track/caption selection dialog, download library/progress/details, file picker and conversion-consent UI.
Video Play/Listen/queue/save/block/removal menus and create-and-save destination sheet.
Shared library floating controls, adaptive panels, confirmations, toolbars and empty states.
Palette/typography/shape/spacing tokens and shared light/dark/opaque glass renderers.
Destination mapping and accessible floating phone dock/wide sidebar.
Replay list, follow/older/errors, dock/overlay editor and appearance/filter/delay settings.
Shared publication labels and video metadata line presentation.
Root Compose shell, browse/watch/library/settings composition, panels, dialogs and navigation/action wiring.
Explicit queue expansion, current occurrence following, bounded inner list, repeat and recovery controls.
Service-controller PlayerView attachment/release, fit surface and visible-video screen wake ownership.
Measured transport/header/footer, full-width timeline slot and compact seek/SponsorBlock feedback placement.
Presentation modes, touch-exploration observation, density-independent drag arbitration and cancellation.
Single-surface mini/watch/fullscreen host, animations, modality/lifecycle gates, chat and ambient integration.
Video controls, timeline/scrub gestures, SponsorBlock prompt, tracks/settings, speed/audio/caption/refresh controls.
Playlist cards/headers, subscribe state and owned title/privacy/description editor.
Feed link warning/copy/share/open and XML share/save sheet with scoped file permissions.
Reusable draft input with keyboard/search/physical Enter submission semantics.
Settings categories, editable preference baselines, explicit save, immediate local toggles, server and About screens.
Global/channel skip settings, inherited modes, color editor and reset/save sheet.
Subscription/channel floating toolbars, scoped inputs, tab and sort controls.
Confirmed membership pill, checking/pending/error states and explicit unsubscribe menu.
Searchable sorted directory, viewing/upload statistics, counts and fallback/errors.
Rich video description, optional exact statistics/credits/notices, safe external intents and channel-resolution dialog.
Members badges, guest/account block actions and blocked-channel manager.
Equal-width labeled watch action circles with disabled state and tooltips.
PixelCopy sampler lifecycle, animation/power gates, color smoothing, contrast-bounded light and separate backdrop scene.
Watch background/wash, refractive action/disclosure materials and floating panel/comment toolbars.
Saveable occurrence resize progress and nested-scroll connection for embedded video.
You identity/dashboard destinations and owned/subscribed playlist library sections/empty states.
